title: Weekly Unit Economics Review — Template (Blended $/1M Output Tokens)
content:
Purpose
- Establish a single weekly cadence for reviewing Redwood’s blended inference unit cost and the drivers behind week-over-week movement.
- Audience: Finance (CFO/FP&A), Product (Console/Hosted API/Optimize), Eng (Telemetry/Platform), SRE/Observability.
- Primary KPI: blended cost of inference as $/1M output tokens (company-level and by required slices).
- Secondary outcomes: agree on follow-ups (pricing/packaging, routing defaults, optimization work), and document notable regressions + mitigations.

Meeting logistics (fill in)
- Week ending (Sun): __________
- Meeting date/time: __________
- Facilitator: __________ (default: FP&A)
- Notetaker: __________
- Data as-of timestamp (pipeline freshness): __________
- Links:
  - Unit Econ dashboard (internal): __________
  - Reconciliation report (vs billing): __________
  - Last week’s doc: __________


0) Pre-read checklist (owner: facilitator)
[ ] Dashboard refreshed and within freshness SLO (note any delays/late partitions)
[ ] Reconciliation vs billing/metering within tolerance (call out variance and why)
[ ] Top movers identified (models/regions/tiers; >X% WoW changes)
[ ] Any known incidents / rollouts / routing changes captured for the week
[ ] Draft narrative written for Exec Summary (Section 1)


1) Exec Summary (2–4 bullets)
- Overall blended $/1M output tokens: $____ (WoW: ____%, absolute: $____)
- Primary driver(s) of change: _________________________________
- Net impact to gross margin (if applicable / directional): _________________________________
- Decisions needed this week: _________________________________


2) KPI Snapshot (company-level)
Fill in values, plus WoW and vs 4-week trailing baseline.

KPI table
- Blended cost ($/1M output tokens)
  - This week: $____
  - Last week: $____
  - WoW %: ____%
  - 4-week avg: $____
- Total output tokens (M)
  - This week: ____
  - Last week: ____
  - WoW %: ____%
- Total requests (optional)
  - This week: ____
  - Last week: ____
- Cache hit rate (prefix/KV; definition per dashboard)
  - This week: ____%
  - Last week: ____%
  - Delta: ____ pp
- Effective discount/credits rate (if included in blended definition; restricted)
  - This week: ____%
  - Last week: ____%

Notes / caveats
- Any data exclusions (late partitions, backfill in progress, known mapping issue): _________________________________
- Any definition changes since last week (should be rare; link ADR/change): _________________________________


3) Reconciliation & Data Quality (Finance + Platform)
Goal: confirm dashboard is usable for decision-making; document any known gaps.

3.1 Reconciliation summary (vs billing/metering)
- Company total variance (dashboard vs billing): ____% (absolute $____)
- By region (top 2 variances):
  - Region: ____  Variance: ____%  Notes: __________________
  - Region: ____  Variance: ____%  Notes: __________________
- By tier (if available):
  - Tier: ____  Variance: ____%  Notes: __________________

3.2 Data health
- Freshness status: ✅ / ⚠️ / ❌  (as-of: ________)
- Completeness status: ✅ / ⚠️ / ❌
- Known issues opened (tickets/owners): _________________________________

Decision gate
- Is the dataset “green” for decisioning this week? Yes / No
- If “No”, what is restricted (e.g., region drilldown, tier drilldown, discount slices): _________________________________


4) Slice-and-dice: where cost moved (Mix shift & drivers)
Use the dashboard’s “Explain” view where available; otherwise summarize manually.

4.1 By customer tier (required)
- Self-serve
  - $/1M: $____ (WoW: ____%)
  - Output tokens share: ____% (WoW: ____ pp)
  - Notes: _________________________________
- Dedicated
  - $/1M: $____ (WoW: ____%)
  - Output tokens share: ____% (WoW: ____ pp)
  - Notes: _________________________________
- Private / Enterprise (as defined)
  - $/1M: $____ (WoW: ____%)
  - Output tokens share: ____% (WoW: ____ pp)
  - Notes: _________________________________

4.2 By region (required)
Top regions by volume; call out any region mix shifts.
- Region: ____  $/1M: $____  Share: ____%  Notes: __________________
- Region: ____  $/1M: $____  Share: ____%  Notes: __________________
- Region: ____  $/1M: $____  Share: ____%  Notes: __________________

4.3 By model family / variant (required)
Call out top models by output tokens and their unit cost.
- Model: ____  $/1M: $____  Share: ____%  WoW share delta: ____ pp  Notes: __________________
- Model: ____  $/1M: $____  Share: ____%  WoW share delta: ____ pp  Notes: __________________
- Model: ____  $/1M: $____  Share: ____%  WoW share delta: ____ pp  Notes: __________________

4.4 By runtime config / optimization levers (optional, but recommended)
- Quantization profile adoption
  - Notable adoption changes (model/region): _________________________________
  - Observed $/1M impact (if measurable): _________________________________
  - Quality/regression notes (if any): _________________________________
- Batching / continuous batching changes
  - Any config changes shipped: _________________________________
  - Expected vs observed: _________________________________
- Caching
  - Hit rate movement explanation: _________________________________
  - Estimated savings delta: $____ (if available)

4.5 Driver attribution (fill in; must sum directionally)
Approximate decomposition of WoW change in blended $/1M:
- Model mix shift contribution: ____% (or $____)
- Region mix shift contribution: ____% (or $____)
- Tier mix shift contribution: ____% (or $____)
- Cache hit rate / cache savings contribution: ____% (or $____)
- Runtime/config change contribution: ____% (or $____)
- Fleet cost / overhead allocation contribution: ____% (or $____)
- Discounts/credits policy impact (restricted; if applicable): ____% (or $____)
- Other/unknown: ____% (or $____)


5) Notable regressions & anomalies (engineering + product)
Criteria (suggested): any slice with WoW $/1M change > +10% OR any sustained upward trend over 2+ weeks.

Regression log (copy rows as needed)
- Slice: (model / region / tier / route) _________________________________
- Symptom: $/1M moved from $____ → $____ (____%)
- First observed: __________
- Suspected cause: _________________________________
- Correlated events:
  - Routing policy change? Yes/No (link: ____)
  - Rollout / model version change? Yes/No (link: ____)
  - Incident / capacity constraint? Yes/No (link: ____)
  - Data pipeline issue? Yes/No (link: ____)
- Mitigation status: Not started / In progress / Done
- Owner: __________
- Next update by: __________


6) Decisions & follow-ups
Capture explicit decisions made during the meeting.

Decisions (this week)
- Decision 1: _________________________________
  - Rationale: _________________________________
  - Affected systems: Hosted API / Dedicated / Private / Console / Optimize
  - Owner: __________

- Decision 2: _________________________________
  - Rationale: _________________________________
  - Owner: __________

Action items (table)
- Action: _________________________________ | Owner: __________ | Due: ________ | Link: ________ | Status: Not started / In progress / Done
- Action: _________________________________ | Owner: __________ | Due: ________ | Link: ________ | Status: Not started / In progress / Done
- Action: _________________________________ | Owner: __________ | Due: ________ | Link: ________ | Status: Not started / In progress / Done


7) Upcoming changes to watch (next 1–2 weeks)
- Planned model rollouts / fallbacks / version pins: _________________________________
- Planned routing policy changes (region or tier): _________________________________
- Planned fleet/hardware changes (capacity, new GPU type, reservation changes): _________________________________
- Pipeline changes (schema, backfills, new dimensions): _________________________________


8) Appendix (optional)
8.1 Definitions (reference)
- KPI: Blended cost per 1M output tokens ($/1M output tokens)
- “Blended” includes compute + overhead allocation per ADR; reconciliation methodology per Finance/Platform agreement.
- Output tokens = tokens generated by the model (not input tokens). If a combined metric is referenced, label clearly.

8.2 Notes for restricted views
- Slices involving account-level detail or discount/credits impacts may be restricted to Finance/Product leadership.
- If restricted data is discussed verbally, summarize at an aggregate level in this doc and link to the restricted view rather than copying numbers.

8.3 Useful links
- ADR (canonical definition): __________
- Data contracts / dimensions & SLOs: __________
- Runbook (backfills / late partitions): __________
- Slack channels: #finance, #eng-platform, #eng-sre, #product-console
